title: Adoption
description: portalr's product analytics, across tenants, for operators (lattice RFC-0008, stackr ADR-0048). Only people who said yes are counted.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM analytics.events ORDER BY tenant_id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM analytics.events ORDER BY tenant_id

panels.title: Active people, by day
panels.description: People who did anything in the tenants chosen, each day: by their keyed hash, never their id.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, uniq(distinct_id) AS people FROM analytics.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND tenant_id IN (${tenant:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Adoption by integration
panels.description: How many people used each integration in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT props['integration'] AS integration, uniq(distinct_id) AS people FROM analytics.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND tenant_id IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND event = 'app.integration.used.v1' AND props['integration'] != '' GROUP BY integration ORDER BY people DESC

panels.title: Funnel: a page, a thread, a message
panels.description: People who opened a page, then a thread, then sent a message, within a day, in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT step, countIf(level >= step) AS people FROM (SELECT distinct_id, windowFunnel(86400)(toDateTime(ts), event = 'app.page.viewed.v1', event = 'app.thread.opened.v1', event = 'app.message.sent.v1') AS level FROM analytics.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND tenant_id IN (${tenant:singlequote}) GROUP BY distinct_id) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3] AS step GROUP BY step ORDER BY step

panels.title: Weekly retention
panels.description: Of the people active four weeks ago, how many came back in each week since.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(r[1]) AS `week 0`, sum(r[2]) AS `week 1`, sum(r[3]) AS `week 2`, sum(r[4]) AS `week 3` FROM (SELECT distinct_id, retention(toStartOfWeek(ts) = toStartOfWeek(now() - INTERVAL 3 WEEK), toStartOfWeek(ts) = toStartOfWeek(now() - INTERVAL 2 WEEK), toStartOfWeek(ts) = toStartOfWeek(now() - INTERVAL 1 WEEK), toStartOfWeek(ts) = toStartOfWeek(now())) AS r FROM analytics.events WHERE ts >= toStartOfWeek(now() - INTERVAL 3 WEEK) AND tenant_id IN (${tenant:singlequote}) GROUP BY distinct_id)
